title: Modified Oxford Maneuver - anesthesiologist protocol
author: Gabriel Magalhães Nunes Guimarães
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rctd2wn

steps.title: Prepare Materials
steps.instruction: Gather all necessary equipment on a flat, clean table.

substeps.instruction: Nitroprusside 25mg/ml (2ml ampoule)
Phenylephrine 10mg/ml (1ml ampoule)
Saline (NaCl 0.9%) bags: 100ml (x2) and 500ml (x1)
Syringes: 20ml (x1), 5ml (x2)
Intravenous catheter (22 gauge)
Catheter connector (Y-connector or three-way connector)
Common medical procedure gloves
Tourniquet
70% Alcohol for skin cleaning

steps.title: Prepare Drug Solutions
steps.instruction: Dilute the medications to a final concentration of 100mcg/ml.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 50mg (2ml) of nitroprusside into 498ml of saline using a 5ml syringe; label the bag and syringe as 'nitro' and cover the bag with a black plastic bag to protect from light.
Dilute 10mg (1ml) of phenylephrine into 99ml of saline using a 5ml syringe; label the bag and syringe as 'phenyl'.
Label a 20ml syringe and a 100ml bag as 'saline'.

steps.title: Perform Catheterization
steps.instruction: Establish intravenous access in the volunteer's arm.

substeps.instruction: Explain the procedure to the volunteer.
Apply the tourniquet 5cm proximal to the basilic vein.
Identify the basilic vein and clean the puncture area with 70% alcohol.
Put on gloves and perform catheterization.
Release the tourniquet.
Connect the Y-connector or three-way connector.
Test the catheter via aspiration and saline flush, ensuring the process is painless.
Examine the arm near the catheter tip for extravascular infusion.
Fix the catheter in place.

steps.title: Load Syringes
steps.instruction: Draw the required volumes of solutions into the labeled syringes.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 5ml from the nitro bag into the nitro syringe.
Aspirate 5ml from the phenyl bag into the phenyl syringe.
Aspirate 20ml from the saline bag into the saline syringe.

steps.title: Execute Initial Infusion Trial
steps.instruction: Administer the initial bolus doses and flushes upon request.

substeps.instruction: Infuse 100mcg of nitro, then flush with 5ml of saline.
Wait one minute, then infuse 100mcg of phenyl, followed by a 5ml saline flush.

steps.title: Execute Adjusted Dose Trials
steps.instruction: Administer adjusted doses as specified for subsequent trials after the patient has rested.

substeps.instruction: Infuse the new dose of nitro and flush with 5ml of saline when requested.
Infuse the new dose of phenyl and flush with 5ml of saline when requested.
Repeat the trial if technical problems occur with monitors.

steps.title: Remove Catheter
steps.instruction: Safely remove the IV access and ensure hemostasis.

substeps.instruction: Remove the catheter.
Instruct the volunteer to press the entry point with sterile cotton.
